source_title: WATCH: Shubman Gill's Female Fan Revives Controversy Linked To Pakistan Star's Send-Off
source_excerpt:
Shubman Gill has become the subject of an unexpected social media discussion after a female cricket fan claimed that the India batter declined her request for a photograph during the team's stay in New Zealand. What has made her complaint stand out is her connection to an earlier controversy involving Gill and Pakistan spinner Abrar Ahmed.
The woman recalled how she had stood up for Gill when Abrar's send-off to the Indian batter during the Champions Trophy 2025 attracted attention. She now claims that when she approached Gill in New Zealand and asked for a picture, the India star turned her down.
In a video circulating online, the fan expressed her disappointment in Hindi, saying: "Maine Abrar Ahmed ke saath New Zealand mai jhagda kiya Shubman Gill ke liye aur jabhi maine abhi New Zealand mai Shubman Gill ko bola, 'Shubman bhai mujhe photo chaiye,' ussne bola 'Sorry'. Acchi baat nahi hai."
Her remarks roughly translate to: "I fought with Abrar Ahmed for Shubman Gill in New Zealand. When I recently asked Shubman Gill for a photograph, he said, 'Sorry'. That was not a good thing."
The latest video has revived memories of the exchange between Gill and Abrar during the India-Pakistan match at the Champions Trophy 2025. The Pakistan spinner's animated send-off after dismissing Gill became a talking point among supporters.
The gesture prompted reactions from fans on both sides, and the woman later attracted attention for confronting Abrar in defence of the Indian batter.

The claim has not been independently verified. The video captures the woman's account of the interaction, but it does not establish the circumstances in which she approached Gill or why he allegedly declined the request.
There is also no confirmed information about the timing or location of the exchange beyond her reference to New Zealand. Gill's side of the incident has not been established in the material available.
The discussion, therefore, rests on the fan's version of events rather than a verified account of what happened between the two. While her disappointment has attracted attention online, the reason behind the alleged refusal remains unclear.
